lessons.title: PHP basics and echo
lessons.summary: Run PHP code on the server, render HTML to the browser.
lessons.explanation: PHP is a server-side language — code runs on the server before the browser ever sees the page. The 'echo' statement outputs text. PHP code lives between <?php and ?> tags.

starterFiles.index.php:
<?php
// store your name in a variable
// echo a greeting
?>
